description: A short historic mining trail that passes through scenic stretches of old growth forest while follow along the American Creek valley. The maintained trail terminates after 3.5 km. (2.4 miles) at a viewpoint overlooking Champion Creek and American Creek.
directions: Drive North from Stewart along Highway 37A for approximately 22 km. (13.5 miles). After crossing the Bear River bridge there will be a highways pullout on the left hand side. Park here and walk back towards Stewart approx. 30 m. (33 yds) to the steep gravel road. Keep to the right, for 300 m. (330 yards) until you reach the trailhead.
